spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the `decisions` of the world the last reset loaded, `spindle.console.World`. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `call`: the HTTP call the environment binds the cause to (`[http.<name>]`). `unanswered`: nothing did, or the cause's HTTP call failed, and the command answered `501`. Source: `crates/spindle-cli/src/decisions.rs:47-71`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/observe.rs:186-213`.

spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.title: ExternalAnswer
spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.description: One external cause a command asked about while a served request was answered, and what answered it.

command.description: The qualified command that asked: the routed command, or one an event binding invoked while the request was answered; the `command` label of `spindle_external_causes_total`.

outcome.description: The outcome whose cause was asked about, as the command declares it.

holds.description: Whether the cause holds; absent when nothing answered it.
